decisions.question: Named-road setback family keyed one way (disclosed)

decisions.question: Four wording variants
decisions.recommendation: "front yard building setback" (front_setback_m); "side lot line abuts a street" and "side lot line that abuts a road" (side_setback_street_m); "from the main walls of the residential building" (separation_m). Settles 929 (F), 200 (C)(ii), 317 (B)(i), 159 (B), 1 (F).
